_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Pugi is working on the logo…

description: Use this when the person wants a new logo, logo options, a brand mark or a brand identity for a business, shop, product or project, whether or not the request names Pugi, for example "make a logo for my bakery" or "make a logo for Blue Fern Bakery". It draws new logos from the interview and takes no uploaded image, so editing or keeping an existing logo file is outside it. A drawn logo changes through refine_logo, its files download from the card when they are ready, and a website can be built from the picked one. Pugi draws up to four whole logo options (PNG) from a short brand interview, the same as on the Pugi logo maker. business_name is the name the person gave, in their own words; with no name given yet, the name comes from the person first (in Russian: «Как называется компания?»), since Pugi draws for a real name only. description and styles are the person's own words about the business and its look; language is the language the person writes in. The first result shows the name in the card for the person to confirm (status needs_input, question id name); each later result is one interview question with its options in the card. An answer comes back with the question_token: trade for the first question, answers for the later ones, draw_now true when the person asks to draw now. The drawing returns state drawing with the question_token and takes about 30 seconds; the same question_token with read_state true returns the finished logos as a replay, with no new charge. A new business name is a new brand. Logos already shown in this conversation change through refine_logo. Generates logo design assets only. Not for photos, illustrations, posters, memes or editing an uploaded image.

answers.description: Every answer so far to the interview questions (status needs_input): the id Pugi gave and the person's own words.

business_name.description: The business name, as written by the user.

colours.description: Optional. Hex colours: {"primary": "#1e3a8a", "secondary": "#f59e0b", "text": "#111827"}, or a list of one to three of them in that order.

description.description: The person’s own description of the business, including location, imagery and mood.

draw_now.description: True when the user wants the logos drawn now, without more questions.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this call, reused only to retry it. The same key with the same arguments is charged once.

industry.description: Optional. What the business does, for example "coffee shop" or "accounting firm".

language.description: The language the person writes in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "uk", "de" or "pt-BR"; the questions come back in it.

name_proof.description: Set by Pugi's card when the person confirms the name; empty in other calls.

question_token.description: The question_token of the last make_logo result. With the trade, the answers or draw_now it continues that interview; without it a new brief starts.

read_state.description: With question_token: reads what the logo card shows now (the drawn logos with their logo_id, state drawing while they are drawn, or that the person is still answering). A read draws nothing and charges nothing.

style.description: Style words; styles also accepts a list.

trade.description: The answer to the first interview question (status needs_input): the slug of the option picked, for example "coffee-shop", or the person's own words.

name: make_logo
title: Make up to four logos
